blocks.intro: CaraCMS is an npm package for Astro sites, free under the MIT licence.

blocks.heading: How it works
blocks.body:
A developer adds it with npx caracms init and describes the site’s blocks in caracms.config.ts.
Editors then sign in at /admin and change the pages they see.

blocks.heading: What you can count on
blocks.intro: The site stays yours: its code, its content and where it runs.

items.heading: Your own repository
items.text: Content is JSON files beside the code. Pages are never kept in a database of ours.

items.heading: Any Node host
items.text: Railway, Render, Fly or a VPS: anywhere that keeps one Node server running behind HTTPS.

items.heading: MIT licensed
items.text: The whole package is free, with no caps. CaraCMS Cloud is there for the annoying parts, if you want it.
